body.statement: For every \((G,T,e)\in\mathcal G_{n,k}\) with \(d_e(G)<\infty\), \[d_e(G)\le 2^{|D|-n+2}\le2^{k+1}.\] The first inequality holds even when the generic full parameter fiber is positive dimensional.
body.justification: This gives the first universal parameterized ceiling for one algebraic edge coordinate beyond directed trees.
body.gap: Existing tree-only identification theory and old higher-degree small SEM examples do not bound a single coordinate by excess-parent count.
body.consumer: A fixed-parameter symbolic engine can allocate elimination degree and certificate storage before seeing numerical covariance values.
